Former Australian Bishop Convicted of Sexual Abuse

Christopher Saunders, the former bishop of Broome, has been convicted by an Australian jury of sexually abusing two men. The District Court of Western Australia jury found Saunders, 76, guilty of 13 out of 19 charges. Australian news outlets reported the conviction, noting Saunders was known for hosting alcohol-fuelled house parties. The victims were described as young Indigenous men.
